title: Riverton City Council Meeting
motion: that the Riverton City Council approve Resolution No. 21- 19 authorizing the Community Scale Plan proposed by Suburban Land Reserve not connect with Sunday Drive, as provided by staff, but adding thereto the following conditions: 1. All streets shall be considered private within the Community Scale Plan. 2. The City will not receive any dedications of streets or utilities within the Community Scale Plan. 3. All matters relating to municipal services such as trash collection, snow plowing, and metering of utilities shall be handled by SLR, a, property management company, or the like. 4. A park
